Your tap, your beer

Whatever's on, wear it with pride.

Put any badge on the screen and Tapstr shows it full size, with the fridge temperature and pints left dropping in for a quick glance.

Health at a glance

Know it's pouring well before you pull.

Pints left, fridge and line temperature, gas pressure and days since the last clean. One health score tells you if all's well, and when it isn't, tap FIX to see what's wrong and how to put it right.

Line cleaning

Clean lines, clean pints.

Tapstr counts the days since your line was last cleaned and lets you know when it's due. Start a clean, flush the line and tap Done. Flow monitoring pauses, so cleaning water never counts as beer.

  1. Days since last clean
  2. Cleaning
  3. All clean

Tap a new keg

New keg? Three taps and you're pouring.

Pick its size, confirm, and you're off. Tapstr resets the count and tracks every pint from the first one.

Temperature control

Dial in the perfect pour.

Tapstr replaces your fridge thermostat. Set upper and lower limits, or let SmartTemp learn your fridge's cooling cycle to hold the temperature steady and go easy on the compressor.

The Tapstr app

Every tap, in your pocket.

On iPhone, Android and in any web browser.

Dashboard

All your taps on one page.

From your laptop, tablet or phone. See pints left, fridge and line temperature, gas pressure, and days since the keg was tapped and the line was cleaned, with the same health score your tap shows on its screen.

Tap badges

Name the beer. We'll find the badge.

Type the name of the beer you're pouring and Tapstr finds badge artwork for it. Pick one, frame it, and it's on your tap's screen in seconds.

Each tap keeps a gallery of its badges, so switching beers is just a swipe. You can upload your own image too.

Temperature

See how your fridge really behaves.

Live temperature and history show how steady it stays. SmartTemp learns your fridge's cooling cycle to hold your target and go easy on the compressor. Prefer fixed upper and lower limits? Switch to Threshold in one tap.

  1. 1 day
  2. 7 days
  3. SmartTemp

Alerts

Know what to do next.

Everything that needs attention across all your taps, in one list. Fix now comes first, then what's coming up, like a keg about to run out. Switch on push notifications and you'll hear about amber and red alerts as soon as they happen.
